title: NPPA Fixes Retail Prices of 34 Drug Formulations Including Gemcitabine, Carbimazole
summary: New Delhi: Through a recent notification, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India, has fixed the retail prices of 34 drug...

contentHtml:
New Delhi: Through a recent notification, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India, has fixed the retail prices of 34 drug formulations, including cardiovascular, anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, anti-infective, gastrointestinal and analgesic medicines, under the provisions of the Drugs (Prices Control) Order (DPCO), 2013.

The notified prices are exclusive of Goods and Services Tax (GST), wherever applicable. The order, S.O. 5998(E), dated November 2, 2026, covers formulations associated with companies including Sun Pharma, Cipla, Mankind Pharma, Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories, Zydus Healthcare, Abbott Healthcare, Alkem Laboratories, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, FDC and Eris Lifesciences.

Among the cardiovascular formulations, Rosuvastatin, Aspirin and Clopidogrel Capsules containing 20 mg, 75 mg and 75 mg respectively, by Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals/Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, have been priced at Rs. 25.21 per capsule. The corresponding combination containing Rosuvastatin 10 mg, with Aspirin 75 mg and Clopidogrel 75 mg, has been priced at Rs. 16.56 per capsule.

Bisoprolol Fumarate, Telmisartan and Cilnidipine Tablets by Windlas Biotech/Eris Lifesciences have been priced at Rs. 19.11 per tablet for the 2.5 mg/40 mg/10 mg combination and Rs. 20.87 per tablet for the 5 mg/40 mg/10 mg combination.

The list also includes Metformin Extended-Release 500 mg and Sitagliptin 100 mg Tablets by Synokem Pharmaceuticals/FDC at Rs. 13.92 per tablet; myo-Inositol 600 mg and Metformin Hydrochloride Sustained-Release 500 mg Tablets by Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals/Zorvia Healthcare at Rs. 24.45 per tablet; and Carbimazole 2.5 mg Tablets by Abbott Healthcare at Rs. 1.34 per tablet.

For injectable formulations, Gemcitabine Injection 1.4 g/36.84 ml, containing Gemcitabine 38 mg per ml, by Adley Formulations has been priced at Rs. 5,623.07 per vial. Ceftriaxone 500 mg and Tazobactam 62.5 mg Injection by Maya Biotech/Vivaldis Health and Foods has been priced at Rs. 125.07 per vial, while Paracetamol Injection 1,000 mg/4 ml by Troikaa Pharmaceuticals has been fixed at Rs. 341.26 per vial.

Methotrexate Oral Solution containing 2 mg per ml, by Beta Drugs/Ipca Laboratories, has been priced at Rs. 12.70 per ml. Methylprednisolone Tablets by Foregen Healthcare/Zorvia Healthcare have been priced at Rs. 5.30 per tablet for the 4 mg strength and Rs. 10.28 per tablet for the 16 mg strength.

The gastrointestinal formulations include Alginate Raft-forming Oral Suspension B.P. by ESPI Industries & Chemicals/Aristo Pharmaceuticals at Rs. 0.97 per ml. Each 5 ml contains Sodium Alginate 250 mg, Sodium Bicarbonate 133.5 mg and Calcium Carbonate 80 mg.

A combikit by Malik Lifesciences/Mankind Pharma, comprising two Clarithromycin 500 mg Tablets, two Vonoprazan 20 mg Tablets and two Amoxicillin 1,000 mg Tablets, has been priced at Rs. 118.52 per strip. Another combikit by Malik Lifesciences/Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories, containing two Vonoprazan 20 mg Tablets and three Amoxicillin 1,000 mg Tablets, has been priced at Rs. 50.53 per strip.

A combipack by Theon Pharmaceuticals/Zydus Healthcare, containing two Vonoprazan 20 mg Tablets, two Clarithromycin 500 mg Tablets and four Amoxycillin 500 mg Capsules, has been priced at Rs. 122.34 per combipack.

Amoxycillin and Potassium Clavulanate for Oral Suspension by Malik Lifesciences/Apex Laboratories has been priced at Rs. 5.10 per ml. The combipack contains a bottle providing Amoxycillin 400 mg and Clavulanic Acid 57 mg per 5 ml of constituted suspension, along with a vial containing 30 ml of Sterile Water for Injections.

The notification also fixes prices for several ophthalmic and ear preparations by Skymap Pharmaceuticals/Wellgen Medicare. These include Ciprofloxacin 0.3% w/v and Dexamethasone 0.1% w/v Eye Drops at Rs. 2.71 per ml; Gentamicin 0.3% w/v and Dexamethasone Phosphate 0.1% w/v Eye/Ear Drops at Rs. 1.75 per ml; Moxifloxacin 0.5% w/v Eye Drops at Rs. 35.37 per ml; and Moxifloxacin 0.5% w/v and Dexamethasone Phosphate 0.1% w/v Eye Drops at Rs. 20.40 per ml.

This came in exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 5, 11 and 15 of the Drugs (Prices Control) Order, 2013, read with S.O. 1394(E) dated the 30th May, 2013, S.O. 5249(E) dated 11th November, 2022 and S.O. 3516(E) dated 30th June, 2026 issued by the Government of India in the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has fixed, the price as specified in column (6) of the table herein below as the retail price, exclusive of Goods and Services Tax, if any, in relation to the formulation specified in the corresponding entry in column (2) of the said Table with the strength, unit and name of manufacturer & marketing company, as specified in the corresponding entries in columns (3), (4) and (5) thereof;

(a) The manufacturer, as mentioned in column (5) of the table above, of formulations i.e., “new drug” under paragraph 2(1)(u) of the DPCO, 2013 shall fix the retail price not exceeding the price as specified in column (6) of the table above.

(b) Any other existing manufacturer launching the same new drug as specified in column (2), (3) and (4) of table above within twelve months of the date of publication of this notification in the Official Gazette is permitted to do so at a retail price not exceeding the price as specified in column (6) of the table above subject to filing of Form-IA on IPDMS 2.0 along with supporting documents within one month of launch.

(c) The manufacturer may add Goods and Services Tax only if they have paid actually or it is payable to the Government on the retail price mentioned in column (6) of the above said table.

(d) The retail price for a pack of the aforesaid formulation shall be arrived at by the concerned manufacturer in accordance with the retail price specified in column (6) of the above table as per provisions contained in paragraph 11 of the DPCO, 2013. The manufacturer shall issue a price list in Form–V from date of notification as per paragraph 24 of the DPCO, 2013 to NPPA through IPDMS and submit a copy to State Drug Controller and dealers.

(e) As per para 24(4) of DPCO 2013, every retailer and dealer shall display price list and the supplementary price list, if any, as furnished by the manufacturer, on a conspicuous part of the premises where he carries on business in a manner so as to be easily accessible to any person wishing to consult the same.

(f) In case the retail price of any of the aforesaid formulations is not complied with, as per instant price notification and notes specified hereinabove, then the concerned manufacturer/marketing company shall be liable to deposit the overcharged amount along with the interest thereon under the provisions of the DPCO, 2013 read with the Essential Commodities Act, 1955.
